text: Risk management is the process of dealing with possible problems before they happen. First, you need to identify risks, which means finding out what could go wrong in a project or business. After that, you develop mitigation strategies to reduce the chance or impact of these risks. For example, you might buy insurance or train your staff. It is also wise to prepare contingency plans, which are backup plans you can use if a risk actually occurs. Finally, monitoring is essential because risks can change over time. By checking your risks regularly, you can adjust your plans and stay prepared. Good risk management helps you avoid surprises and protects your goals.
